plan.help.missing.q: What if I can’t find an item?
plan.help.missing.a: Use “Custom item” in any room. Enter a name, quantity and description — the team reviews the effort.
plan.help.assembly.a: You choose per piece: ready to move, or dismantled, reassembled or both by the team. Dismantling and reassembly are part of the price.
plan.help.price.q: When will I see the price?
plan.help.price.a: First add your locations, inventory and schedule. Your full price breakdown appears at Review & price — calculated by our system, not in your browser.
plan.help.photos.q: Can I add photos of my home?
plan.help.photos.a: Yes, up to 10 photos. For now they stay in your browser; the team will ask for them if needed.
plan.help.contact.q: How do I contact the company?
plan.help.contact.a: Write to us through the contact form on our website (Questions) – we usually reply within one working day.

pricing.intro: These are the numbers the server prices every job with. A change applies to new quotes at once; existing quotes and orders keep their price. Every change is logged with its old and new value.
pricing.readOnly: You can view the rates but not change them.
pricing.loadFailed: The rates could not be loaded.
pricing.invalid: Enter a number with at most two decimals, e.g. 1.20.
pricing.saved: Saved — applies from the next quote.
pricing.exampleShort: Standard per-km rate. VAT and the quote’s other lines come on top.
pricing.exampleLong: Long distance: the long-distance rate applies to the whole distance.
pricing.footnote: The server works out the distance from the two addresses. Customers see it in their breakdown as “km × price per km”.
pricing.group.travel.hint: Moves only: every kilometre between the old and the new address.
pricing.group.base.hint: What a job costs before scope, distance or extras.
pricing.group.area.hint: When a job is priced by living area rather than by items.
pricing.group.extras.hint: Floors without a lift, add-on services, crew and Saturdays.
pricing.group.terms.hint: Applied to every quote once all its lines are added up.
pricing.group.duration.hint: Not a price: decides whether a job takes a second day.
pricing.rate.per_km.hint: For distances up to the long-distance threshold.
pricing.rate.per_km_long_distance.hint: From the long-distance threshold, for the whole distance.
pricing.rate.long_distance_from_km.hint: From this distance on, the long-distance rate applies.
pricing.rate.base_rate_moving.hint: The fixed part of every move.
pricing.rate.base_rate_disposal.hint: The fixed part of every junk removal.
pricing.rate.base_rate_cleaning.hint: The fixed part of every cleaning.
pricing.rate.per_sqm_cleaning.hint: Floor area to clean × this rate.
pricing.rate.floor_surcharge_percent.hin: Per floor without a lift, on the base rate and scope.
pricing.rate.parking_zone.hint: Flat rate for the permit and signs.
pricing.rate.transport_insurance_percent: Share of the base rate and scope.
pricing.rate.crew_of_three_surcharge.hin: Per job with a crew of three.
pricing.rate.second_van_surcharge.hint: Per job with a second vehicle.
On the subtotal when the date is a Saturday.
pricing.rate.minimum_order_value.hint: Net; smaller jobs are raised to it.
pricing.rate.vat_percent.hint: The statutory rate; change only when the law changes.
pricing.rate.hours_per_sqm.hint: Extra time per m² of living area.
